Vyzhnytsia New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernivtsi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Vyzhnytsia was the founding seat of the Vizhnitza Hasidic dynasty, established here in 1854 by Rabbi Menachem-Mendel Hager (1830–1885) — a dynasty whose influence is documented at numerous other sites throughout this collection, including Verkhivka, Banyliv, Berehomet, Kitsman, and Putyla. The Sadigur and Boyan Hasidic dynasties, both documented elsewhere in this collection, also predominated locally. By 1888, the town supported eight synagogues catering to Jews of different professions, and the Jewish population reached a peak of 5,080 people (89 percent of the town) in 1910. On August 8, 1941, following a pogrom that killed 21 people that July, 1,820 Jews were deported to Transnistria, with the remnants following that October; most survivors later emigrated to Eretz Israel.
